mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, code, name, description, is_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted_by, delete_reason, deleted_at FROM iam_role WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, tenant_id, code, name, description, is_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted_by, delete_reason, deleted_at FROM iam_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, code, name, description, is_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted_by, delete_reason, deleted_at FROM iam_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_role SET name = #{role.name}, description = #{role.description}, is_enabled = #{role.enabled}, updated_by = #{role.updatedBy}, updated_at = #{role.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{role.id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
